basic_info.description: Stunning Condo boasts 3 Beds, 3 Baths on 2 Levels With partial Downtown Views and Fun, Relaxing Backyard. Enter on the main level to a lrg Lvg/Dng/Kit Combo w/Maple Floors & Downtown Views. Kitchen has S/S Appliances, Gas Stove, Granite counters and a great center patio for outdoor Grilling. The Master Bedroom is in the rear w/tranquil outlooks over Designer backyard, generous walk-in Closet, Huge Master Bath, w/Custom Tile, Soaking Tub & Large Shower. A Guest bed & Bath complete this level. An impressive Staircase to the lower level brings you to the 3rd bedroom or home office with full bath. This level also boasts a Media Room with built in speakers and direct access to backyard. This is the North Slope Condo You've Been Waiting For!
